description.value: Smart N Save is a supermarket in Richmond offering weekly specials and delivery services. As a general grocery store, it provides a practical stop for touring cyclists needing supplies, food, and provisions on their journey.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: bollard at 56m; stands (4 spaces) at 59m; rack at 63m; rack at 73m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 91m. Total: 8 spaces.
